chef_rush_persona_blockers.title: Bottom-row card buttons cut off below viewport fold at 1920x1080 with ≥6 orders
chef_rush_persona_blockers.owner_mandate_verbatim: il doit y avoir maximum 5 commandes affichées en une ligne, sinon faire 2 lignes. Chaque commande doit être lisible sans scroll. Sinon le chef sous stress va sortir une commande incomplète.

evidence.math: grid_top(164) + 2*row(462) + gap(16) + padding(32) = 1136px ⇒ overflow by 56px ⇒ bottom-row Prêt buttons OR end-of-card content below fold.

fix_options: A. Adaptive 1-row layout: ≤5 active orders ⇒ single row of 5 columns at full card height ~880px (no overflow), ≥6 ⇒ 2 rows of 5 cols = 10 slots, vertical card height ~440px each, rows fitting in 880+16+32 = ~970 < 1080
B. Dynamic compaction: row count = ceil(N/5), col count = max(min(N,5), N_per_row), with min card-height clamp 380px so chef stays glanceable. Caps at 10 displayed (1+9 overflow indicator pill).
C. Owner-mandate strict: 5-col grid with 'plus N' overflow chip in lower-right if N>5 ⇒ chef KNOWS extras exist behind a click (vs current silent slice 0,8).
